origin: Published Olmon single-crystal and McPeak gold optical datasets; figure-digitized Fontijn magnetite
goldProtocol: At native n,k nodes form epsilon = (n+ik)^2; interpolate real and imaginary epsilon linearly in wavelength. Default epsilon is the equal-weight mean of the two interpolated endpoints. No extrapolation.
magnetiteProtocol: Interpolate the figure-digitized diagonal epsilon linearly in photon energy, using hc = 1239.8419843320026 eV nm. No magneto-optical tensor terms.
